name: video_specialist_agent
description: Video/TV/X1 troubleshooting specialist. Owns the multi-turn Video conversation (XRE error codes, black/frozen screen, channel/entitlement, remote issues, and XIT video recommendations) once the orchestrator transfers to it. Reuses cached account/outage/XIT context and only runs video-specific tools. Transfers back to the orchestrator for Internet/Outage topics and to a human for escalations. Only reached when video_flow_enabled is 'true'.
